title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
author: Arthur C. Clarke
description: A black monolith found on the Moon sends a crewed ship toward the outer planets, with a ship's computer that has its own idea of the mission.
reasons: want expansive, big-idea sci-fi about humanity's place in the universe
are fascinated by AI that quietly goes wrong
liked the film and want the parts it left unexplained
like cool, precise prose about real spaceflight
dislikes: The human characters are flat on purpose, and it shows
The middle stretch reads like a technical manual
The ending is vaguer in feeling than the film's, despite explaining more
